title: The Twin-Spur Casting Treatise
summary: Teaches casting two darts from a double-spurred board, loosed together, split or staggered against one foe or two.

title: Basin-Wide Dart Rain Doctrine
summary: Sets out how darts are lobbed in sheets across a whole basin, covering a wide field of ground from one position.

title: Azure Hawk's Closed-Wing Dart Book
summary: Teaches the closed-wing cast, a dart thrown from stillness that strikes with a hawk's sudden speed and no warning.

title: River-Run Pursuit Casting Canon
summary: Covers casting at a running foe along banks and shallows, keeping pace with the quarry and bringing it down.

title: Paired Court Volley Compendium
summary: Gathers the volley craft of two throwers working as one, from the shared count to the closing crossfire.

title: Treatise on the Mirrored Flight of Twin Darts
summary: Shows how two darts are flown as mirror images, so that one foe's guard against the first opens the way for the second.

title: Oath-Flight Dart Canon of the Plateau
summary: Binds each cast to a spoken oath of the plateau, so the dart flies on a vow and does not stray.

title: Gale Bearing Treatise on Storm-Cast Darts
summary: Teaches the casting of darts in rising storm wind, using the gale's push to carry them past ordinary range.

title: Compendium of the Unwalled Cast
summary: Trains the thrower to fight with no cover, nothing behind and open sky above, trusting stance and bearing alone.

title: Casting Rules of the Wind's Edge
summary: Sets rules for casting along a cliff or plateau rim, where the wind is strongest and a fall is a risk.

title: Book of the Hundred-Bearing Volley
summary: Teaches the shifting of bearing through a long volley, so darts come from many lines and the foe cannot set a guard.

title: Standing Oath Doctrine of the Far Thrower
summary: Holds the far thrower to a standing oath, a fixed stance under any attack, from which the longest casts are made.
